snippet.title: Lobotomy - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Get a look at the Launch Trailer for Lobotomy, a first-person psychological horror game developed by Yousf Jawhar. Players will navigate through the darkness of an asylum to record experiments, survive what lingers, and escape before becoming an experiment themselves. Lobotomy is available now for PC (Steam).
